title: Vampire Vape Raspberry Sorbet 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Vampire Vape Raspberry Sorbet 10ml is an exquisite E-Liquid. It delivers a delightful fruity puff of summer pleasure in every decadent inhale and exhale you take. When you add this summery 10ml E-Liquid to your vape device you will be able to envelop your tastebuds in the mouth-watering summery flavour of Raspberry Sorbet. Each super smooth puff carries rich, ripe raspberries for a tart and sweet inhale, followed by a touch of tickly fizz and a smooth, delicate hint of menthol for an irresistible all-day vape. Making it the perfect addition for any vapers fruity E-Liquid collection. Go ahead and indulge your tastebuds in a refreshingly sweet burst of juicy summer berries you won’t regret it. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 3mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage, sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
